title.value: Shortlist business-trip hotels into a Google Sheet

introduction.value: A Claude in Chrome shortcut searches Booking.com for hotels near downtown under a price cap and logs each with price, rating, distance, amenities and booking link in a Google Sheet.

method.value: You create a /hotel-picker shortcut in Claude in Chrome that starts from Booking.com. It applies the Hotels-only, distance and 4-star-plus filters, then checks Booking.com and TripAdvisor reviews. You set up a Google Sheet with headers. A prompt gives Claude the trip, dates, price cap and sheet URL, and it adds a row per hotel.

outcome.value: The source says results come back in about 10–15 minutes as a top-10 list sorted by value. It gives no tested results or accuracy numbers.

notes.value: Needs a Claude Pro account. Use a dedicated Chrome profile to limit logins, and don't click in the active tab. If anti-bot protections trigger, ask Claude to type slowly.

source_text.body:
Shortlist business-trip hotels into a Google Sheet
A Claude in Chrome shortcut searches Booking.com for hotels near downtown under a price cap and logs each with price, rating, distance, amenities and booking link in a Google Sheet.
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
You create a /hotel-picker shortcut in Claude in Chrome that starts from Booking.com. It applies the Hotels-only, distance and 4-star-plus filters, then checks Booking.com and TripAdvisor reviews. You set up a Google Sheet with headers. A prompt gives Claude the trip, dates, price cap and sheet URL, and it adds a row per hotel.
How it went
The source says results come back in about 10–15 minutes as a top-10 list sorted by value. It gives no tested results or accuracy numbers.
Worth knowing
Needs a Claude Pro account. Use a dedicated Chrome profile to limit logins, and don't click in the active tab. If anti-bot protections trigger, ask Claude to type slowly.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Search Booking.com for hotels near [location] under [price cap] per night, and log each match into a Google Sheet with price, rating, distance from downtown, amenities and the booking link. Stop once you have a shortlist of at least [number] options for me to review.
Original source: https://app.therundown.ai/guides/use-claudes-chrome-extension-to-quickly-book-business-trips
